S1:13.text: And Iacob ſaid: My lord thou knoweſt that I haue with me litle ones, and ſheepe, and kine with young which if I cauſe to ouerlaboure themſelues in going, in one day al the flockes wil die.

S1:17.text: And Iacob cometh into Socoth where hauing built a houſe, and pitched his tents, he called the name of that place Socoth, that is, Tabernacles.

S1:18.text: And he paſſed into Salem a citie of the Sichimites, which is in the land of Chanaan, after he returned from Meſopotamia of Siria: and he dwelt beſide the towne.

S1:19.text: And he bought that part of the field, wherin he had pitched his tents, of the children of Hemor, the father fo Sichem for an hundred lambes.

S1:6.text: And the handmaides and their children coming nere, bowed themſelues.

S3:12.text: he ſaid Let vs march on together, and I wil accompanie thee in thy iourney.

S3:17.text: And Iacob cometh into Socoth where hauing built a houſe, and pitched his tents, he called the name of that place Socoth, that is, Tabernacles.

S3:18.text: And he paſſed into Salem a citie of the Sichimites, which is in the land of Chanaan, after he returned from Meſopotamia of Siria: and he dwelt beſide the towne.

S3:19.text: And he bought that part of the field, wherin he had pitched his tents, of the children of Hemor, the father fo Sichem for an hundred lambes.

S3:2.text: and he put both the handmaids & their children foremoſt: and Lia, and her children in the ſecond place and Rachel, and Ioſeph laſt.

S3:6.text: And the handmaides and their children coming nere, bowed themſelues.

S3:7.text: Lia alſo with her children came nere and when they had adored in like maner, laſt Ioſeph and Rachel adored.

S6:13.text: And Iacob Sheep, My Lord thou knoweſt that I haue with me litle ones, and IOI and kine with yong: which if I cauſe to ouerlabour themſelues in going, in one day al the flocks wil die.

S6:16.text: Eſau therefore returned that day the ſame way that he came, into Seir.

S6:17.text: And Iacob commeth into Socoth where hauing built a houſe, and pitched his tents, he called the name of that place Socoth, that is Tabernacles,

S6:18.text: and he paſſed into Salem a citie of the Sichimites, which is in the land of Chanaan, after he returned from Meſopotamia of Siria: and he dwelt beſide the towne.

S6:19.text: And he bought that part of the field, wherin he had pitched his tents, of the children of Hemor, the father of Sichem, for an hundred lambs.

S6:20.text: And erecting an altar there, on it he called vpon the moſt Mightie God of Iſrael.

S6:8.text: And Eſau ſaid: What are the troupes that I did meet He anſwered That I might find grace before my Lord.
